name: 911 Setup
description: Automates the full 911 QTDR batch setup behind a checklist of actions to run: creates nest folders, copies and fills 911 Batch templates with forecast, PDF, and quote data, generates inspection sheets, and stamps the Move Ticket Omit PDFs (with a toggleable difficulty label). Nest numbers are sourced from the Quote File NEST column.
author: Anthony Sieben

setup: Sync the '911 QTDR' folder in OneDrive and make sure the batch's folder (e.g. S035) is there with its BATCH LIST and NEST PACKAGES.
Keep the Working Forecast List up to date and synced - the app pulls each nest's forecast data from it.
Close any nest workbooks or PDFs from an earlier run that are open in Excel or Acrobat, so the app can overwrite them.
how_it_works: Enter the batch number, then check which nests to set up (nests already built are flagged).
For each nest it creates the nest folder, copies and fills the 911 Batch template with forecast, material, and quote data, and builds the per-piece inspection sheets.
It also pulls the nest's drawings PDF, removing the MOVE TICKET pages and stamping the cover with the batch and nest.
output: One folder per nest, each with a filled '911 BATCH {batch} {nest}.xlsx' and its inspection sheets.
A '{nest} MOVE TICKET OMIT.pdf' drawings file in each nest folder.
A scribe-verification doc dropped into each nest's PRODUCTION PAPERWORK folder.
